name: [RELEASE!] Card Chronicles
desc:
Card Chronicles 🎴
Roll anime cards, build your deck, and battle bosses and endless waves. Chase rare pulls, unlock powerful abilities, and climb for the rarest cards.

🎲 Roll for anime cards and rare borders
🛡️ Build your strongest deck and upgrade your power
⚔️ Fight bosses, minibosses, and world bosses
♾️ Survive Infinite mode across Normal, Hard, and Nightmare
🍀 Upgrade luck, roll speed, and cooldowns

💠 Rare cards have unique global serial numbers
🔥 Limited event cards
📱 PC, Mobile, and Console supported!
